title: Parts manifest
description: `W/parts/manifest.json`, written by the scout in part mode (ADR-0019): which part reader reads which sheets, tables and clusters, in which order. It names where to look, never a value: no field holds a quantity, a size or a mark, and every object refuses fields it does not list. `harness part manifest-check W` checks it against the work folder. A sheet is a pair `file` (the path in inventory.json) and `sheet` (the detector sheet id of `harness list-sheets`), because a detector id is only stable inside one file. A cluster is the triple `file`, `sheet`, `side` that `harness unassigned-clusters` reports once per file, frame and side (`sheet` is null for text no frame range holds).

blocks.description: The building blocks of the set; each has its own grid. A member part names one of them.

acks.description: The engineer's or orchestrator's acknowledgement of a warning of `part manifest-check`, with the question that holds it or the reason it is accepted. `part manifest-check` clears the warning whose `id` equals `warning` exactly; an ack that names no current warning, two acks of one warning, or a `question` that is no id of question-registry.json (any status) is a problem.

part_id.description: Fixed ids: all-grid-levels, all-notes-materials (kind cross), scout, all-assembly (kind bookkeeping), all-no-sheet (kind no_sheet); the rest are <block>-<family> or <block>-<family>-<letter> (kind member).

sheet_id.description: Detector sheet id as `harness list-sheets` prints it, '<space>#NN'.

file.description: Drawing file as listed in inventory.json.

grid_system_ids.description: Grid systems of grid-systems.json that belong to this block.

origin_note.description: Where the block's grid origin sits on its plan, in words.

number_entry.description: The entry of the printed sheet number.

title_entry.description: The entry of the sheet title.

views.description: The views of the sheet this part reads: each is found by the entry of its heading or by a box.

bbox.description: x0, y0, x1, y1 in the sheet's drawing coordinates.

cluster_ref.description: A cluster of text outside every frame, as `harness unassigned-clusters` reports it per (file, frame, side): the triple is its identity.

sheet.description: The frame the cluster was assigned to; null when no frame range holds it (side none).

table.description: A table the part reads: on a sheet (`file` and `sheet`) or in a cluster (`cluster`), with the entries of its header row.

block.description: A member part: the id of one of `blocks`.

family.description: A member part: the member family, e.g. piles or caps.

order.description: Load path: a part with a lower order is read before one with a higher order.

inputs.description: Parts that must be locked before this one is read.

layers.description: Layers the part reads its linework from.

marks_regex.description: Regular expression of the member marks of this part.

split_of.description: The part this one was split from (size cap), e.g. NX1-caps for NX1-caps-a. A cross part over the cap is split as <fixed id>-<letter> with kind cross and split_of the fixed id (e.g. all-notes-materials-a); it then also stands for the fixed id.

files.description: A no_sheet part: DWG/DXF files that `harness list-sheets` skips (no text index, or an unreadable one) and that this part takes over, so that `harness part manifest-check` does not report them as file_unread. A files entry that is unused (the part is not no_sheet, or `harness list-sheets` does not skip the file) is reported as `files_entry_unused` by `harness part manifest-check`.
